title: FAQ for riders, parks and manufacturers
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Common questions (Can I use this now? Why not leg loops? Does it replace the lap bar? Water rides? Who certifies it?) need consistent answers.
objective: Write an FAQ with 20–30 questions grouped by audience, every answer linking to the source document.
acceptanceCriteria: First answer: it is not ready or approved for use
Every answer links to a repo document
